name: @tellma/locale-ar
description: Arabic locale pack for Tellma distributions — library strings (Transloco scope) plus the self-hosted Noto Sans Arabic font subset.

Measured 0.44 once tmArabic loads ./platform-strings and ./strings together, within the ceiling. Measured 0.46 once tmArabic loads ./shell-strings beside them and merges it under tm, within the ceiling. Measured 0.48 once tmArabic also loads ./queryex-strings and merges it under tm, within the ceiling. Measured 0.50 (512 B), at the ceiling, once tmArabic also loads ./details-strings and merges it under tm. Raised from 0.5 to 0.55 once tmArabic also loads ./support-strings and merges it under tm: measured 0.52 against 0.50 before (+0.02 KB, the sixth import() and its merge), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.05 KB. Measured 0.54 once tmArabic also loads ./dashboards-strings and merges it under tm (+0.02 KB, the seventh import() and its merge), within the ceiling. Measured 0.56 KB on a clean build of the merged tree once tmArabic also loads ./attention-strings and merges it under tm (the eighth import() and its merge), over the 0.55 ceiling, so the ceiling rises to that measurement rounded up to the next 0.05 KB, 0.6. Measured 0.57 on a clean build once tmArabic also loads ./pins-strings and merges it under tm (the ninth import() and its merge), within the 0.6 ceiling.
budgetNotes../attention-strings: Born at 1.26 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB: the Arabic tm.attentionPanels and tm.attentionRows strings, which tmArabic loads beside the other tables. A table of its own, as ./shell-strings is at its ceiling. Raised from 1.5 to 2 for the Arabic tm.attentionPages strings (the Notifications section of My settings: the pop-up card, the grid, the save status, the test delivery card and the section's two page actions): measured 1.26 at its birth and 1.66 after (+0.40 KB), the raise being that addition rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. Savings considered: a table of its own would add a tenth import() and its merge to tmArabic's 0.6 KB primary for a table that loads at the same moment, so the strings stay here.
budgetNotes../pins-strings: Born at 1.13 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB, as a part of its own beside ./shell-strings, which is at its ceiling (2.50 of 2.5): the pinned bar's Arabic (the landmark, More, the pin control's two names and its reasons, Manage pins and its launcher command, the empty lines, the pinned toast and the announcements, and a revoked or unavailable chip's name and message) under pins, the bar's menus and popover (the popover's titles, name, folder select with No folder and New folder…, the folder's name, Remove and Done, the empty folder, Unpin and the move announcements) under pinOverlays, and the Manage pins dialog (the empty lines, the folder lists' names, the rows' Rename, Move to and Remove, No access and Not available, New folder with its default names and the ten-folder reason, the bar's switch, Cancel and Save, and the move announcements) under managePins, the imperatives in either gender's form. tmArabic loads it beside the other parts on the first switch to Arabic and merges it under tm. Nothing was saved: every string is one the user reads.
budgetNotes../platform-strings: Born at 2.84 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB, by the re-split of ./strings that replaced its third raise: the platform's Arabic tm table (every block of it, from the home and settings titles, the errors, the session, the update banner, the navigation, the launcher and the shell to the entity strings, the attention surfaces and the arrival toasts, the typed values and the picker), which tmArabic loads beside ./strings on the first switch to Arabic and an app on the component library alone never loads. Raised from 3 to 3.5 for the entity actions' Arabic: measured 2.84 before and 3.15 after (+0.31 KB), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the default action confirmation's question with its plural forms and gendered imperative, the confirmation loop's title, Continue, skip and more lines with their plural forms, and the action dialog's failure, item and outcome-unknown strings. Saved the skip line's few and many forms, which repeated its other form (3.16 to 3.15); every remaining string is one the user reads. Raised from 3.5 to 4 for the column filters' Arabic: measured 3.15 before and 3.51 after (+0.36 KB), the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the tm.filter block: the control's labels, the fourteen operators' names and one whole-sentence description per operator, so a translation orders its words as Arabic does. Savings looked for: every string is one the control or a filter chip shows. The shell's Arabic, whose frame and tenantless pages would have made this entry point's third raise (about 4.02 against 4, 3.51 before), went to ./shell-strings instead, with the shell scope it already held: measured 3.45 after. The device time zone's Arabic fits within the ceiling: measured 3.45 before and 3.73 after on its branch (+0.28 KB), and 3.82 on the merged tree. The weight is the zone block (the automatic update's toast) and the zonePrompt block (the prompt's title and message, the option and its hint, both answers and its two failures, the imperatives in either gender's form). Measured 3.72 after the launcher's Arabic moved to ./shell-strings (-0.10 KB on the merged tree).
budgetNotes../support-strings: Born at 0.92 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB: the support tools' Arabic, the support dialog's title, Close, placeholder and offline lines under supportHost, and the Diagnostics panel's header, values, live-update states, request grid, outcomes and buttons under support, the imperatives in either gender's form. It is its own entry point rather than part of ./platform-strings, which it would have taken over its ceiling (3.86 of 4), and tmArabic loads it beside the others on the first switch to Arabic.
budgetNotes../shell-strings: Born at 0.99 KB measured, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB, by a re-split of ./platform-strings in place of its third raise: the Arabic of the shell frame (the skip link and the tenant list's title), the shared Sign in, and the tenantless pages (the app bar's language and account menus; the tenant picker's title, search, loading line, Connect with its accessible name, the seven badges, the three unavailable reasons, the empty state with its gendered forms, the no-match, failure and not-found lines; the signed-out page's title, message, signed-in line and Continue). tmArabic loads it beside ./platform-strings and ./strings on the first switch to Arabic and merges it under tm. Nothing was saved: every string is one the user reads, and the pack loads only on the first switch to Arabic. Raised from 1 to 2, its first raise, for the tenant shell: measured 0.99 before and 1.98 after (+0.99 KB), the raise being that addition rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the Arabic of the tenant shell and its app bar (the cold sync's lines, the markers and their accessible-name suffixes, the slots, the session button's name), the session menu and its popovers (the rows, Theme, Language and Calendar, the marker texts and the live tenant's link), the About dialog (the versions, the update alert with Reload and Reload anyway, the legal lines) and the Shortcuts dialog (its sections, headers, the grid's and the launcher's labels, the filter and its no-match line), with the gendered imperatives. Options measured and not taken: ./platform-strings may not grow, and ./queryex-strings has 0.25 of headroom, a quarter of the addition. Measured 2.00 after the tenant shell's review, within the ceiling: the installed-mode Back and Forward moved to their own scope, the cold launch's account name without a tenant was added, and the About row reuses the dialog's title, whose duplicate left. Raised from 2 to 2.5 for the support tools' rows in the shell: measured 2.00 before and 2.04 after (+0.04 KB), the ceiling being the measure rounded up to the next 0.5 KB. The weight is the session menu's Report a problem and the About dialog's Diagnostics tab, whose labels render before the support tools load, so they cannot live in ./support-strings, which tmArabic merges by scope and whose scopes are the support tools' own. Savings taken: the Diagnostics tab's loading and failed lines and the About tab's label reuse the strings already here. Measured 2.50 on the merged tree once the launcher joined it, within that ceiling (+0.46 KB on the 2.04 the support rows left; the launcher measured +0.45 on its own branch): the tm.launcher block, with the headings, the pinned row's name and the create row, the no-match line, the instructions and the footer with the gendered imperatives, the plural count and bucket announcements, and the three platform entries' search synonyms, which moved here from ./platform-strings so the launcher's Arabic lives in one table.
budgetNotes../dashboards-strings: Born at 0.34 KB measured on a clean build, the ceiling being that measurement rounded up to the next 0.5 KB, as a part of its own beside ./platform-strings, which may not be raised again: the home page's Arabic (its title, which moved here from ./platform-strings because the merge under tm is shallow and the home scope must be whole in one table, the three greetings and the grid's label) and the dashboard grid's (the not-available and failed-load headings, and the recently visited widget's title and empty state). tmArabic loads it beside the other parts on the first switch to Arabic and merges it under tm.

budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
